**4B.5 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

**Bottom line:** negative overall. I found only limited, indirect evidence of institutional restraint and legal space for criticism; the stronger 2024 record is attack on critics, electoral-commission overhaul, judicial capture concerns, and surveillance/militarization of neutral institutions.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| 20.05.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador | Presidencia de México | 2024-05-20 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-05-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/ | AMLO said conservatives were “adversaries, not enemies” and that repression, authoritarianism, and censorship were unnecessary. This is limited positive evidence against a pure loyalty-test / intimidation posture. | 4B.5, 3B.3, 4B.3 |
| Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob; presidente celebra ejemplar transición en gobierno federal | Presidencia de México | 2024-08-13 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/ | After the election tribunal validated the presidential election, AMLO’s government publicly celebrated an “ejemplar transición.” This is indirect positive evidence against personalist entrenchment and cult-like refusal to cede office. | 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.4 |
| México | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico | The Reuters Institute says Gálvez obtained a court-ordered right of reply to AMLO’s false claims. This is limited positive evidence that independent institutions still constrained him and that criticism could force a legal remedy. | 4B.5, 4B.4, 4B.3 |
| México | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico | AMLO’s final year featured continued verbal attacks on journalists, human-rights advocates, and the media. That is negative evidence for intimidation of critics and a hostile, personalized political climate. | 4B.5, 3B.3, 4B.3 |
| Mexico | Reuters via Yahoo News Canada | 2024-02-26 | https://ca.news.yahoo.com/mexicos-president-defends-decision-share-174417727.html | AMLO publicly displayed a New York Times journalist’s phone number and defended the move. This is a concrete intimidation episode against critical media. | 4B.5, 3B.3, 4B.3 |
| Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906 | Reuters reported AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul critics said could cement Morena’s political hegemony and lower the bar for referendums. This is strong negative evidence for party capture and politicization of electoral institutions. | 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.2 |
| Mexico’s sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588 | Reuters reported AMLO’s judicial overhaul was formally enacted amid criticism that it weakened judicial independence. This is negative evidence for politicizing courts and weakening neutral constraints. | 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.4 |
| Mexico | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House says the government used insecurity to justify expanding state surveillance with little accountability, and that a covert SEDENA cyberspace unit monitored critics using inauthentic accounts. This is direct negative evidence of politicizing state machinery against critics. | 4B.5, 4B.2, 3B.8 |
| Mexico | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights | HRW warned AMLO’s proposed constitutional changes could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards. This is broad negative evidence of politicization of neutral institutions rather than self-restraint. | 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.4 |
| Mexico | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396 | Reuters reported the Senate approved a reform giving the armed forces control of the civilian-led National Guard, with critics warning it gave the military too much power over law and order. This is negative evidence of militarizing a neutral institution. | 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.8 |

**Search gap:** I found little direct 2024 evidence of formal “personality cult” rituals or explicit loyalty tests. The best evidence is indirect: hostile rhetoric, attacks on journalists and critics, and institutional capture through INE, courts, surveillance, and militarization.
